title: Product review
prompt: [MEETING] Product review — company week 3, day 5 (2026-08-03). FIRST call list_issues: if the backlog already holds more than 8 cards, create NOTHING new this cycle — instead improve, merge or sharpen existing cards and say so. A backlog nobody can build is waste. Then run the product review: check the co-founder inbox for answers, read VISION.md and the board, then update ROADMAP.md with write_repo_file — each feature with an explicit value case (who benefits, what metric moves). Kill or defer features without one. File new accepted features as issues with due dates.
